tagline: A leading regional bank serving the western United States with comprehensive financial solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Net Interest Margin is the primary profitability driver for regional banks like COLB, reflecting the efficiency of balance sheet management and interest rate management in a fluctuating monetary environment.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest revenues generated and borrowing costs, expressed as a percentage of productive assets.
kpis.description: Net Interest Margin expanded from 3.57% in 2024 to 3.83% in 2025, supported by a reduction in the cost of interest-bearing debt and a more favorable deposit mix.
kpis.signal: Margin expansion driven by lower cost of funds and a more favorable funding mix.

kpis.name: Total Consolidated Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets held by the bank, including loans, securities, and liquidity.
kpis.description: Total assets increased from $51.6B at end of 2024 to $66.8B at end of 2025, driven by the acquisition.
kpis.signal: Significant balance sheet growth following the Pacific Premier acquisition.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all charges, taxes, and provisions.
kpis.description: Net income increased from $534M in 2024 to $550M in 2025, despite an increase in share count due to the acquisition.
kpis.signal: Modest net income growth despite shareholder dilution.

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.explanation: Total amount of customer deposits, the primary funding source for the bank.
kpis.description: Deposits increased by $12.5B, rising from $41.7B to $54.2B, supported by $14.5B brought by Pacific Premier.
kpis.signal: Strong deposit growth driven by the acquisition and commercial campaigns.

kpis.name: Total Loans and Leases
kpis.explanation: Total outstanding loans provided to customers, the primary income-generating asset.
kpis.description: Total loans increased by $10.1B, rising from $37.7B to $47.8B, primarily driven by the acquisition.
kpis.signal: Significant credit portfolio expansion following the acquisition.

kpis.name: Non-Performing Loans Ratio
kpis.explanation: Loans in default or past due as a percentage of total, an indicator of credit risk.
kpis.description: Non-performing loans decreased from 0.44% to 0.41% of total, despite integration of riskier assets via Pacific Premier.
kpis.signal: Slight improvement in portfolio quality despite the acquisition.

kpis.name: CET1 Capital Ratio
kpis.explanation: Key indicator of financial strength and resilience to shocks, expressed as a percentage of risk-weighted assets.
kpis.description: CET1 ratio improved from 10.5% to 11.8%, demonstrating good absorption of the acquisition from a regulatory standpoint.
kpis.signal: Significant strengthening of capital following the acquisition.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount distributed to shareholders per share held.
kpis.description: Annual dividend increased from $1.44 to $1.45, with a quarterly increase to $0.37 in November 2025.
kpis.signal: Modest dividend increase, reflecting a stable distribution policy.

kpis.name: Merger and Restructuring Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs related to integrating an acquired business, including advisory fees, systems conversion, and restructuring.
kpis.description: Merger expenses increased from $24M in 2024 to $148M in 2025, directly related to the acquisition.
kpis.signal: Elevated temporary costs associated with the strategic Pacific Premier acquisition.

kpis.name: Share Repurchase
kpis.explanation: Amount allocated to repurchasing own shares to create shareholder value and reduce shares outstanding.
kpis.description: The company repurchased 3.7 million shares for $100M, under a $700M program approved in October 2025.
kpis.signal: $700M commitment over one year, with an initial $100M repurchase in 2025.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and Security Failures
risks.score_rationale: The company is vulnerable to cyberattacks and operational system failures, which could have a material impact on business, reputation, and financial results. The report emphasizes that cybercriminal techniques are constantly evolving and complete prevention is not guaranteed.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company recently completed the acquisition of Pacific Premier, which carries integration risks, including loss of key employees, business disruption, and significant costs ($148M in 2025). The report emphasizes the importance of successful integration.

risks.title: Technology and IT Infrastructure Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on technology for critical operations: deposit processing, loan management, and online banking services. Any major failure could disrupt operations and impact customer confidence.

risks.title: Key Employee Retention
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risk of losing key employees, due to competition for talent in the financial sector and disruptions related to the Pacific Premier integration. The report emphasizes the importance of retention.

risks.title: Credit Risk and Economic Deterioration
risks.score_rationale: The company faces credit risk in the event of economic deterioration in the southwestern regions where it operates. The report emphasizes the importance of managing real estate concentrations and credit risk to ensure financial stability.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has not mentioned artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar terms in the excerpts provided from its 10-K/20-F documents. Therefore, its AI positioning cannot be determined from this information.
